property_summary: For any successful payable call to fallback with exactly 10 ether and strictly increasing block.timestamp over the previously recorded pastBlockTime, the reference contract always records pastBlockTime equal to the current block.timestamp; the mutant records block.number instead, so for some inputs (where block.timestamp != block.number) the stored public pastBlockTime will differ and the property is violated.
change_summary: Change the assignment to record pastBlockTime as block.number instead of block.timestamp, altering stored value observed via the public variable.
